newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PT&T says 1995/96 net loss 37.98 mln peso.
newsitem.headline: PT&T says 1995/96 net loss 37.98 mln peso.

text.p: Philippine Telegraph & Telephone Corp said on Friday it incurred a net loss of 37.98 million pesos for the fiscal year 1995/96 ended June.
This is the second straight year of losses. Last year, the company reported a net loss of 28.29 million pesos.

In a report to stockholders, PT&T president Jose Luis Santiago said that despite a net loss, the company's operating revenues rose by 13.7 percent to 523.11 million pesos from last fiscal year's 460.07 million pesos.
The company's operating expenses rose by 17.4 percent to 509.18 million pesos from 433.55 million pesos.
PT&T, a Filipino company, is an international gateway facility operator.
